1	---
2	title: 'Story 6.5 — Proactive Insight Injection & Failure Isolation'
3	type: 'feature'
4	created: '2026-11-06'
5	status: 'in-review'
6	review_loop_iteration: 0
7	baseline_commit: '09b24965a5ca704f231b1899c7792e83f150bf87'
8	context: ['{project-root}/_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/epic-6-context.md']
9	---
10	
11	<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">
12	
13	## Intent
14	
15	**Problem:** The assistant never surfaces a pattern from the user's own history unprompted — `ChatRepository` has no insight-generation method, `ChatReady` has no slot for one, and nothing counts messages or idle time within a session.
16	
17	**Approach:** `ChatCubit` tracks a per-session trigger window (5 user messages sent OR 2 minutes idle, whichever first) and fires `ChatRepository.generateInsight()` fire-and-forget through `isolatedSideEffect` (story 6.4's helper, its first unawaited caller) the instant the window closes, reopening a fresh window immediately. A successful, `status: 'ready'` result is appended onto `ChatReady` as a single nullable `activeInsight` value — rendered as the ochre-spine "INSIGHT" card at the end of the message list — never a second state container. Any failure (transport or in-payload `status != 'ready'`) is silently dropped.
18	
19	## Boundaries & Constraints
20	
21	**Always:**
22	- Per active session: a counter (user messages sent via `sendMessage` only, never `retryMessage`) and a `Timer` (restarted on every `sendMessage` and every fire) race; whichever hits its threshold first calls `generateInsight(sessionId, triggerType:, triggerKey:)`, then immediately resets the counter, generates a fresh `triggerKey`, and restarts the timer — before the network call resolves, so the window closes structurally and the other condition can never also fire for it.
23	- The call goes through `isolatedSideEffect`, **unawaited** — the first caller not to await it (6.4's `bookmarkMessage` does await it).
24	- A failure — transport `Left`, or a 200 with `status != 'ready'` (RF08: "never an HTTP error; a failure becomes `status='failed'`") — is dropped silently: no card, no overlay, no retry affordance.
25	- `ChatReady.activeInsight` (nullable `ChatInsight`) is the only new state; the 3 existing direct `ChatReady(...)` constructions in `_bootstrap`/`switchSession`/`startNewSession` already start it `null` — only the counter/timer need an explicit reset call at those sites.
26	- `dismissInsight()` clears `activeInsight` via a direct `ChatReady(...)` construction (`copyWith`'s `??` can't express "set to null", same reason `restoreScrollOffset` never clears instead of fixing `copyWith`); never calls the backend (no dismiss endpoint in the contract) and never touches any other field.
27	- An insight resolving after `switchSession`/`startNewSession` moved away is dropped (`ChatReady.sessionId` no longer matches).
28	- Insight card tokens (spine width, card padding, label spacing, dismiss icon size) go in `design_tokens.dart`, never hardcoded (AGENTS.md).
29	
30	**Ask First:** none — the single-nullable-`activeInsight` shape, reset-before-fire ordering, and the `Duration` test seam are reasonable technical decisions for a mechanism-only story (`docs/input/` silent on them; AGENTS.md: "decide and proceed").
31	
32	**Never:**
33	- Never call the backend on dismiss, or show a card / surface `errorCode` for any `status` other than `'ready'`.
34	- Never let the counter/timer leak across sessions.
35	- Never route insight generation through `SaveChatMessageAsEntryUseCase`/`EntriesRepository`.
36	- Never await the insight `isolatedSideEffect` call.
37	- Never persist `ChatInsight` (no new Hive box, no cross-session reconciliation unlike bookmark state).
38	
39	## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix
40	
41	| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
42	|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
43	| 5th user message | `sendMessage()` called a 5th time within the current window | `message_count` trigger fires once; counter/key reset, fresh timer starts | N/A |
44	| 2 minutes idle | No `sendMessage()` call for the configured duration since the window opened | `inactivity` trigger fires once; counter/key reset, fresh timer starts | N/A |
45	| Near-simultaneous | 5th message sent right as the inactivity timer would fire | Only `message_count` fires — sending synchronously cancels/restarts the timer first | N/A |
46	| Generation fails | `generateInsight` resolves `Left` or `Right` with `status != 'ready'` | `activeInsight` stays null; composer/bubbles/chat unaffected | Silently dropped |
47	| Session switched mid-flight | `switchSession`/`startNewSession` called while a call is pending | Result dropped on arrival — `sessionId` no longer matches | N/A |
48	| Dismiss | `dismissInsight()` tapped | `activeInsight` → null; scroll position and every other field unchanged | N/A |
49	| Dismiss with none active | `dismissInsight()` called while `activeInsight` is already null | No-op | N/A |
50	
51	</frozen-after-approval>
52	
53	## Code Map
54	
55	- `lib/features/chat/domain/entities/chat_insight.dart` (new) -- plain `ChatInsight` (`id`, `content`; manual `==`/`hashCode`/`toString`, mirrors `ChatSession`) + `enum InsightTriggerType { messageCount, inactivity }` + a `wireValue` extension mapping to `'message_count'`/`'inactivity'` (names don't match wire strings, unlike `EntrySource.name`).

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** The assistant never surfaces a pattern from the user's own history unprompted — `ChatRepository` has no insight-generation method, `ChatReady` has no slot for one, and nothing counts messages or idle time within a session.

**Approach:** `ChatCubit` tracks a per-session trigger window (5 user messages sent OR 2 minutes idle, whichever first) and fires `ChatRepository.generateInsight()` fire-and-forget through `isolatedSideEffect` (story 6.4's helper, its first unawaited caller) the instant the window closes, reopening a fresh window immediately. A successful, `status: 'ready'` result is appended onto `ChatReady` as a single nullable `activeInsight` value — rendered as the ochre-spine "INSIGHT" card at the end of the message list — never a second state container. Any failure (transport or in-payload `status != 'ready'`) is silently dropped.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Per active session: a counter (user messages sent via `sendMessage` only, never `retryMessage`) and a `Timer` (restarted on every `sendMessage` and every fire) race; whichever hits its threshold first calls `generateInsight(sessionId, triggerType:, triggerKey:)`, then immediately resets the counter, generates a fresh `triggerKey`, and restarts the timer — before the network call resolves, so the window closes structurally and the other condition can never also fire for it.
- The call goes through `isolatedSideEffect`, **unawaited** — the first caller not to await it (6.4's `bookmarkMessage` does await it).
- A failure — transport `Left`, or a 200 with `status != 'ready'` (RF08: "never an HTTP error; a failure becomes `status='failed'`") — is dropped silently: no card, no overlay, no retry affordance.
- `ChatReady.activeInsight` (nullable `ChatInsight`) is the only new state; the 3 existing direct `ChatReady(...)` constructions in `_bootstrap`/`switchSession`/`startNewSession` already start it `null` — only the counter/timer need an explicit reset call at those sites.
- `dismissInsight()` clears `activeInsight` via a direct `ChatReady(...)` construction (`copyWith`'s `??` can't express "set to null", same reason `restoreScrollOffset` never clears instead of fixing `copyWith`); never calls the backend (no dismiss endpoint in the contract) and never touches any other field.
- An insight resolving after `switchSession`/`startNewSession` moved away is dropped (`ChatReady.sessionId` no longer matches).
- Insight card tokens (spine width, card padding, label spacing, dismiss icon size) go in `design_tokens.dart`, never hardcoded (AGENTS.md).

**Ask First:** none — the single-nullable-`activeInsight` shape, reset-before-fire ordering, and the `Duration` test seam are reasonable technical decisions for a mechanism-only story (`docs/input/` silent on them; AGENTS.md: "decide and proceed").

**Never:**
- Never call the backend on dismiss, or show a card / surface `errorCode` for any `status` other than `'ready'`.
- Never let the counter/timer leak across sessions.
- Never route insight generation through `SaveChatMessageAsEntryUseCase`/`EntriesRepository`.
- Never await the insight `isolatedSideEffect` call.
- Never persist `ChatInsight` (no new Hive box, no cross-session reconciliation unlike bookmark state).

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| 5th user message | `sendMessage()` called a 5th time within the current window | `message_count` trigger fires once; counter/key reset, fresh timer starts | N/A |
| 2 minutes idle | No `sendMessage()` call for the configured duration since the window opened | `inactivity` trigger fires once; counter/key reset, fresh timer starts | N/A |
| Near-simultaneous | 5th message sent right as the inactivity timer would fire | Only `message_count` fires — sending synchronously cancels/restarts the timer first | N/A |
| Generation fails | `generateInsight` resolves `Left` or `Right` with `status != 'ready'` | `activeInsight` stays null; composer/bubbles/chat unaffected | Silently dropped |
| Session switched mid-flight | `switchSession`/`startNewSession` called while a call is pending | Result dropped on arrival — `sessionId` no longer matches | N/A |
| Dismiss | `dismissInsight()` tapped | `activeInsight` → null; scroll position and every other field unchanged | N/A |
| Dismiss with none active | `dismissInsight()` called while `activeInsight` is already null | No-op | N/A |

1. **The hang** (`app_drawer_test.dart`, `main_test.dart`): both files closed the same `ChatCubit` twice — once via the new spec-6-5 wrapper (needed to satisfy `flutter_test`'s `!timersPending` check before the insight-feature's always-running `Timer`), and again via pre-existing teardown. A second `close()` on an already-closed `Cubit` never resolves inside `flutter_test`'s fake-async zone. Fixed by guarding each second close with `isClosed` checks.

2. **The flaky assertion failure** (`chat_cubit_test.dart`, "2 minutes idle"): the inactivity trigger correctly refires every window per spec ("fires once ... fresh timer starts") — the test's bug was sleeping a fixed real-wall-clock multiple (150ms) of a very short injected timeout (20ms), which reliably let several refires happen instead of catching just the first one. Fixed by polling until the first call lands and asserting immediately, rather than oversleeping into the next window. Verified across 5 repeated runs with no flake.
